description.mekmm.recycler: A machine that destroys things you don't need, if there are recipes.
description.mekmm.planting_station: An advanced machine capable of growing crops.
description.mekmm.cnc_stamper: A machine that relies on molds to process items.
description.mekmm.cnc_lathe: A machine with many functions for processing materials.
description.mekmm.cnc_rolling_mill: A machine that uses mechanical force to bend metal.
description.mekmm.presser: A machine that compresses multiple items into one.
description.mekmm.replicator: A machine that violates the laws of physics and can replicate items using a certain substance.
description.mekmm.fluid_replicator: A machine that violates the laws of physics and can replicate fluids using a certain substance.
description.mekmm.chemical_replicator: A machine that violates the laws of physics and can replicate chemicals using a certain substance.
description.mekmm.ambient_gas_collector: A machine that extracts mysterious substances from the atmosphere.
description.mekmm.wireless_charging_stat: A machine for wireless charging of inventory and armor (including Curios, if you have one).
description.mekmm.wireless_transmission_: A machine capable of wirelessly transmitting five types of substances.
description.mekmm.author_doll: A doll with the author's skin.(Just decorations)
description.mekmm.modeler_doll: A doll with the modeler's skin.(Thanks to everyone who provided textures and models for mekmm)
